description: Screen the companies of the coverage as the Screener page of Annalist does, or rank them by one measure. With screen, the conditions of the page joined by commas: roic.gt.12 (latest value above 12; lt below), roic.gt.12.y5 (above 12 in each of the last 5 fiscal years), om.up.3 (higher than the year before in each of the last 3 fiscal years; dn lower), dte.chg.gt.0.5.y1 (change over the last fiscal year above 0.5), roic.top.25 (among the highest 25% of the companies screened; bot the lowest; .s within the sector) and band.in.minimal-modest (credit and quality signals: band, cover, netdebt, fcf, backing, altman, piotroski, beneish). start runs a starting screen such as rising-debt or high-returns. Each company comes with the figures behind each condition and its page, and page links the same screen for a person. Without screen, where and sort filter and rank by the latest value of ratio ids with a frequency, as corp.roic@ttm or corp.current_ratio@quarterly; an amount such as corp.net_debt is ranked within its currency. Call without arguments to list the measures and the starting screens.

basis.description: with screen: latest (default) for the last 4 quarters where reported, fy for the latest fiscal year of every company

country.description: ISO 3166 country code, for example US, GB, ID or HK

currency.description: keep the companies that report in one currency, for example USD

industry.description: part of an industry name, for example Semiconductors or Banks

markets.description: with screen: ISO country codes, for example ["SG", "ID"]

screen.description: the conditions of a screen, for example roic.gt.12.y5,nde.lt.2 or band.in.significant-aggressive

sector.description: part of a sector name, for example Technology or Health care

sort.description: the measure to rank by, for example corp.operating_margin@ttm

start.description: a starting screen of the Screener page, for example high-returns, rising-debt or credit-watch

where.description: conditions that every company meets, for example [{"measure": "corp.roic@ttm", "min": 15}]

name: screen_companies
title: Screen companies
